scenarios.Book.title: A librarian imports 3,000 books; one row arrives without a title. Is the book still a book? Non-null makes the import bug loud. (non-null wins)
scenarios.Book.coverUrl: The cover CDN times out for 20 minutes. With non-null, every book page, list and search result that shows a cover is blank. (nullable wins)
scenarios.Club.owner: Kemi deletes her account; The Midnight Readers has 7 other members who want to keep the club. With non-null, the club page errors until someone patches data. (nullable wins)
scenarios.Review.author: Hugo deletes his account; Shelfie keeps reviews as "former member". With non-null, `[Review!]!` takes the whole review list, and the book page with it. (nullable wins)
scenarios.Book.averageRating: A new book has no reviews. Non-null forces 0.0, a lie that sorts it last and looks like a terrible book. (nullable wins)
scenarios.User.handle: Handles are required at sign-up and live in the users row. Nullable forces every client to handle a case that cannot happen. (non-null wins)
scenarios.Club.memberCount: The last member leaves a club. The count is 0, computed in-process; nothing can fail independently. (non-null wins)
scenarios.Club.currentBook: The Midnight Readers finished October's book and vote on December's next week. (nullable wins)
